title: 「It would be wrong to say that ...」禮貌而精確地否定過度概括

titleEn: Using “It would be wrong to say that ...”

formula: It would be wrong to say that + complete clause

formulas.formula: It would be wrong to say that + complete clause

example: It would be wrong to say that all young people are careless with money.
exampleZh: 若說所有年輕人都不懂得小心理財，便不正確。

examples.en: It would be wrong to say that all young people are careless with money.

examples.highlight: It would be wrong to say that all young people are careless with money.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：It would be wrong to say that + complete clause。

rules.zh: That 後面必須接完整句子 正確： 不完整：
rules.en: Follow that with a complete clause. Correct: It would be wrong to say that all students dislike homework. Incomplete: It would be wrong to say that all students disliking homework.
examples: It would be wrong to say that all students dislike homework.
It would be wrong to say that all students disliking homework.

rules.zh: Wrong 在這裏不一定表示「道德上錯誤」 在這個句型中，wrong 通常表示： ● inaccurate 不準確； ● unfair 不公平； ● misleading 容易令人誤解； ● too general 過於籠統； ● unsupported 缺乏證據支持。
rules.en: Wrong here means inaccurate, unfair, misleading, too general or unsupported, rather than morally wrong.

rules.zh: Would 能令語氣較柔和 較直接： （那個說法是錯的。） 較委婉： （若說每名僱員都感到滿意，便不正確。） 第二句較適合討論、會議、作文及正式分析。
rules.en: Would softens the tone. Compare the direct “That statement is wrong” with the more tactful “It would be wrong to say that every employee is satisfied.” The second version still makes a clear judgement, but it frames it as a careful evaluation and therefore suits discussions, meetings, essays and formal analysis better.
examples: It would be wrong to say that every employee is satisfied.

rules.zh: 這個句型常用來修正絕對化說法 常見的絕對化字眼包括：
rules.en: The structure often corrects absolute claims. Common absolute words include all, every, always, never, no one, completely, only, everyone and in every case. Example: Not every expensive product is reliable. → It would be wrong to say that every expensive product is reliable.
examples: Not every expensive product is reliable.
→ It would be wrong to say that every expensive product is reliable.

rules.zh: 必須保留原句的否定範圍 意思是：有些學生沒有合格。 這不等於： 意思是：沒有學生合格。 因此，改寫時不可把 not all 錯誤地變成 none。
rules.en: Preserve the scope of negation. “Not all students passed” means that some students did not pass; it is not equivalent to “No students passed”, which means that none passed. Do not turn not all into none when rewriting.

rules.zh: 不要與 It is wrong that ... 混淆 （若說這個計劃已經失敗，便不正確。） 這句評價的是「說法」。 （有些工人受到不公平對待，是不對的。） 這句評價的是「情況或行為」。
rules.en: Do not confuse “It would be wrong to say that ...” with “It is wrong that ....” “It would be wrong to say that the plan has failed” evaluates a statement. “It is wrong that some workers are treated unfairly” evaluates a situation or action.
examples: It would be wrong to say that the plan has failed.
It is wrong that some workers are treated unfairly.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能讓你修正 all、always 和 never 等過度概括的說法，而不需要完全否定整個觀點。
benefits.en: It helps you correct an overgeneralisation This structure allows you to challenge words such as all, always and never without rejecting the whole topic.

benefits.zh: 與其直接說「你錯了」，這個句型讓你把焦點放在說法本身，避免令人覺得你在批評說話者。 第二種說法較冷靜、客觀，也較容易讓對方接受。
benefits.en: It makes disagreement sound less aggressive. Instead of saying “You are wrong”, you can focus on the statement rather than attacking the speaker. Compare: You are wrong. Not every teenager is irresponsible. It would be wrong to say that every teenager is irresponsible. The second approach is calmer, more objective and easier for another person to accept.

benefits.zh: 你可以承認某個問題確實存在，同時指出它並不適用於所有人或所有情況。
benefits.en: It helps you express a balanced opinion You can acknowledge that a problem exists while showing that it does not apply to every person or situation.

benefits.zh: 在作文、討論及簡報中，當你需要分析某項主張、證據、調查、政策或社會問題時，這個句型尤其 實用。
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, discussions and presentations This structure is especially useful when evaluating claims, evidence, surveys, policies and social issues.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能幫助你控制立場的強度，清楚指出哪一項結論過於武斷，而不是用另一個極端說法反 駁。
benefits.en: It helps you control the strength of your claim Instead of making another extreme statement, you can explain exactly which conclusion goes too far.

benefits.zh: 記住 It would be wrong to say that… 這個框架後，你在討論中便能迅速組織一個謹慎而有條理 的回應。
benefits.en: It provides a ready-made speaking frame Once you remember “It would be wrong to say that…”, you can organise a careful response quickly during a discussion.
